description: React component for the Team Info tab in the Mattermost web application, managing team name, description, and icon updates with save/cancel functionality.

methods.name: handleNameDescriptionSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of team name and description changes, validating inputs and calling patchTeam API.

methods.name: handleTeamIconSubmit
methods.description: Handles uploading of a new team icon, validating and calling setTeamIcon API.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Coordinates saving of name, description, and icon changes, updating UI state accordingly.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets save panel state and error flags when closing the tab.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Reverts changes to team name, description, and icon, and closes the save panel.

methods.name: handleTeamIconRemove
methods.description: Removes the team icon via API call, handling errors and updating UI state.

methods.name: updateTeamIcon
methods.description: Handles file input change, validating file type and size before setting as new icon.

methods.name: handleNameChanges
methods.description: Updates team name state and marks unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleDescriptionChanges
methods.description: Updates team description state and marks unsaved changes.
